title: Piedmont Crescent Bank Personal Credit Cards Rate Sheet
content:
Rates on Personal Credit Cards are quoted as annual percentage rates. The purchase rate is assigned at approval within the tier's band; the cash advance rate, the penalty rate and the rate cap that applies while military status is active duty are fixed by tier. The penalty rate columns also state how many days a minimum payment must be past due before it applies and how many consecutive on-time minimum payments remove it.

| Tier | Lowest purchase rate | Highest purchase rate | Cash advance rate | Penalty rate | Days late before the penalty rate applies | On-time payments that remove it | Military rate cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 26.49 | 26.49 | 29.49 | 29.99 | 60 | 6 | 6.0 |
| College Rewards Visa | 21.49 | 28.49 | 29.49 | 29.99 | 60 | 6 | 6.0 |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 15.24 | 24.24 | 28.99 | 29.99 | 60 | 6 | 6.0 |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 19.24 | 28.24 | 29.49 | 29.99 | 60 | 6 | 6.0 |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 20.24 | 28.24 | 29.49 | 29.99 | 60 | 6 | 6.0 |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 18.24 | 25.24 | 27.49 | not applicable | 60 | 6 | 6.0 |

All figures are percentages.

Secured Visa is the one tier quoted at a single purchase rate, its lowest and highest both 26.49 percent. Platinum Low Rate Visa opens at the lowest purchase rate of the six, 15.24 percent, and carries the lowest ceiling, 24.24 percent. Visa Infinite Private Client is the one tier whose penalty rate is not applicable, and it carries the lowest cash advance rate, 27.49 percent. The trigger of 60 days, the cure count of 6 consecutive on-time minimum payments and the military cap of 6.0 percent are the same on every tier.
